families.name: NORMALIZATION
families.coverage: FROM-first rewriting, DISTINCT grouping, CTEs, predicates, ordering, SKIP/TAKE, CASE, IN, BETWEEN and inline schemas.

families.name: CLONE
families.coverage: Query, WHERE, JOIN/APPLY, CASE, CTE, ordering, NULL, IN, star, equality and BETWEEN spans through cloning.

families.name: REWRITE
families.coverage: Predicate expansion, source rewriting, grouping, CTEs, star expansion, interpretation sources and SELECT/ORDER BY output nodes.

families.name: GENERATED_BOUNDARY
families.coverage: Generated-source diagnostics retain generated locations and do not invent SQL related locations.

contract.observation: The revision-1 contract and pre-observation manifest remained immutable after observation; no oracle correction was required.

initialCandidateReplay.finding: Source spans were lost or widened while parser nodes were cloned, normalized, rewritten, semantically rebound and expanded into generated result fields. Unknown generated mappings also required a separate source-domain boundary.

focusedReplay.coverage: The permanent matrix executes 48 frozen source-provenance cases across normalization, clone, rewrite and generated-source boundaries, plus a wrong/clamped origin-map control that must fail the exact-origin assertion when mutated.

productionFindings.description: Parser, clone, semantic-binding and rewrite paths did not consistently preserve exact original-source spans, and generated-source facts needed to remain outside the SQL coordinate domain.
productionFindings.repair: Capture token-derived spans at parser boundaries, copy spans through clone and semantic trees, propagate them through rewrite and star expansion, retain the interpretation method span separately, and leave generated diagnostics in the generated-source domain.

obligations.REC-122-O01: The normalization, clone and rewrite families cover FROM-first rewriting, alias substitution, star expansion, CTEs, synthetic grouping, predicates, result modifiers, interpretation sources and emitted interpretation nodes.
obligations.REC-122-O02: Every focused assertion compares transformed spans with the original parsed span or an exact substring in the original query and rejects whole-query widening.
obligations.REC-122-O03: Generated-boundary cases require GeneratedSource locations with no SQL related locations; SQL nodes receive locations only from exact parser or propagated source mappings.
obligations.REC-122-O04: The wrong/clamped origin-map mutation control proves that the exact-origin assertion fails for an incorrect map; the frozen contract and matrix remain unchanged.
obligations.acceptance: Unknown mappings remain unknown instead of pointing to a plausible unrelated SQL token.

notes: The first full-gate attempt was retained under .campaign-artifacts/REC-122-full-gate; it exposed three exact diagnostic regressions and three maintainability-family growth failures. The repaired source passed the focused regressions and the fresh final gate.
The source and test payload were unchanged after the authoritative final gate; only evidence, report, ledger and progress administration follows it.
Product and empirical lanes remain outside the selected engine-lane stopping contract.
